feeds.title: ABC News
feeds.description: Your home of Australian stories, conversations, and events that shape our nation. ABC Australia is one of the most trusted sources of local, national, and world news. Stay tuned to read comprehensive, independent, in-depth analyses, of the latest business, sport, weather, and more.

feeds.title: News.com.au
feeds.description: News.com.au is Australia's leading news website featuring the latest breaking news, national and world stories, sports, business, and finance news, technology news, and travel and entertainment news.

feeds.title: 9news
feeds.description: Nine News is Australia's most trusted source of news and current affairs. Nine's experienced team has delivered breaking news, features, and exclusive news from around Australia and the world into homes since 1956.

feeds.title: The Sydney Morning Herald
feeds.description: Sydney Morning Herald delivers breaking news from Sydney, Australia, and the world. Features the latest business, sports, entertainment, travel, lifestyle, and technology news.

feeds.title: The Age
feeds.description: The Age is Melbourne's leading news provider, in print and online, since 1854. The Age has the latest local news on Melbourne, Victoria. Read National News from Australia, World News, Business News, and Breaking News stories.

feeds.title: SBS News
feeds.description: SBS is the national multilingual, multicultural, and Indigenous media organization for all Australians. The channel is your source to read about the latest happening in Australia. It includes news, sports, entertainment, documentaries, film, food, radio, and television schedule with program information.

feeds.title: The GC Minute
feeds.description: The GC Minute is the Gold Coast's best media source for independent local news, tech, business, and critical city insights through an easy-to-use, non-paywalled website and premium weekly newsletter. The Minute's team of experienced researchers, writers, and dedicated digital specialists go beyond the headlines to deliver insightful stories and information that matter to our readers and the community.

feeds.title: Cairns News
feeds.description: The website www.cairnsnews.org offers a variety of news articles covering topics such as COVID-19, government agendas, climate change, voting fraud, and more. Recent posts include discussions on US politics, environmental issues, healthcare, and international relations.

feeds.title: The Canberra Times
feeds.description: The Canberra Times has been serving the national city as the source of Canberrans' trust when it comes to the news that matters. It delivers the latest news from Canberra, ACT including sports, weather, entertainment, and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Business News
feeds.description: Delivering news, events, and data-based insights for close to three decades, business leaders and influencers trust Business News' independent team as the source for accurate and insightful information and intelligence on commerce, politics, and industry.

feeds.title: Australian Newsagency Blog
feeds.description: Australian Newsagency Blog is a blog on issues affecting Australia's newsagents, media, and small businesses generally.

feeds.title: Sydney Sun
feeds.description: Sydney Sun is an online news publication serving Australia's biggest city and metropolitan area for more than a decade. Its mission is to keep the people of the city informed and updated by providing a comprehensive and diverse news experience.

feeds.title: PerthNow
feeds.description: PerthNow, Western Australia's latest news and stories including business, sport, entertainment, international and more. Its mission is to provide up-to-date local, national and international news, sport, business and entertainment to Western Australians.

feeds.title: Brisbane Times
feeds.description: Brisbane Times gives breaking news from Brisbane plus a local perspective on national, world, business and sport news.This blog contains sections including Politics, Sport, Life and Style, Entertainment, Business, Technology, Property, Food and Travel.

feeds.title: WAtoday
feeds.description: WAtoday is proudly committed to being a trusted, independent voice for WA, providing quality analysis and opinions on the stories that matter to you. The newspaper brings you breaking news from Perth and Western Australia, plus a local perspective on national, world, business, and sports news.

feeds.title: Kalkine Media
feeds.description: Kalkine Media Pty Ltd. is an independent global media house and investor relations group based out of Sydney, Australia, with its wings spread across different geographies. The intent is to keep the readers abreast of the latest developments and hot news across equity, currency, and commodity markets.

feeds.title: Crikey
feeds.description: Independent from the mainstream media, and in some instances, independent from their own views, we've set out to explain and dissect the news agenda for an intelligent, skeptical, socially and politically aware audience. Read news, investigations, analysis, and opinion across politics, world affairs, business, society, and culture.

feeds.title: The Shovel
feeds.description: Australia's satire news website.

feeds.title: Independent Australia
feeds.description: Independent Australia is a progressive journal, that supports freedom and justice for individuals, and getting to the truth. IA opposes governments of the country beholden to vested interests. Our main editorial focus is on federal politics, democratic government, the environment, human rights, Australian identity, and more.

feeds.title: Goulburn Post
feeds.description: The Goulburn Post serves the city of Goulburn and the Southern Tablelands. It covers the outlying towns and villages of Crookwell, Taralga, Gunning, Marulan, Tallong, Bungonia, Tarago, and Collector. Goulburn Post delivers the latest news from Goulburn NSW including sport, weather, entertainment, and lifestyle.

feeds.title: The Werribee News
feeds.description: Werribee News is the local newspaper of Werribee, Victoria state. The theme of this paper is the promotion of the local community. Get news stories and events from in and around Werribee presented by young inspiring upcoming journalists.

feeds.title: 16 News
feeds.description: 16 News is your source to stay tuned and updated on the latest breaking news, headlines, and coverage from the various areas of Newcastle and Australian News.

feeds.title: International Business Times AU
feeds.description: International Business Times (IBTimes) is a growing digital global news publication that delivers international business news. IBTimes provides comprehensive content around the most important business, economic and political stories from around the world, while also adhering to other niche areas that interest global readers.

feeds.title: Perth Herald
feeds.description: Perth Herald chronicles all the latest news about this city located on the banks of the Swan River. The online newspaper features mining and metals news, reflective of the huge impact the mining industry has on Perth and the north of the state which is substantially resources-rich. Perth Herald provides Australian news, international news, and business.

feeds.title: Ozzie News
feeds.description: Ozzie News is an online newspaper and blog for Australians, by Australians. Ozzie News is a newspaper featuring the latest news and trending stories in Australia.

feeds.title: The West Australian
feeds.description: All latest news from The West Australian.

feeds.title: Daily Telegraph
feeds.description: Daily Telegraph is the voice of Sydney and NSW. We strive every day to make the lives of our readers better by keeping them informed and advocating on their behalf. Breaking Sydney's biggest news stories first, we deliver the most up-to-the-minute global, national and local news to a highly-engaged audience.

feeds.title: InDaily
feeds.description: InDaily is South Australia's only locally owned, independent source of digital news. Go to InDaily for up-to-date news, opinion, business, sport, arts & culture, food & wine, real-estate, design, and events.

feeds.title: The Australian Jewish News
feeds.description: The Australian Jewish News is your source for all Jewish-related news in Australia. From its humble beginnings in 1895 as the Hebrew Standard of Australasia, the Australian Jewish News has grown into a quintessential part of the story of Australian Jewry.

feeds.title: Best in Australia
feeds.description: Best in Australia is an all-Aussie website dedicated to bringing you news and opinions covering a variety of topical subjects. As our name implies; we focus on reporting the absolute best stories to come out of this great nation. Many of our articles deliver in-depth opinions and analysis on everything from controversial public issues to home improvement projects.

feeds.title: Herald Sun
feeds.description: The Herald Sun is Victoria's home for breaking news, footy, and hard-hitting opinion and holds the title of Australia's most-read newspaper. Stay updated on the headlines and the latest news from Australia and the World.

feeds.title: Gold Coast Bulletin
feeds.description: Gold Coast Bulletin gives you the best and latest news, information, and entertainment about the Gold Coast - Australia's sixth-largest city. We'll keep you up-to-date with the latest local, state, national, and world news along with extensive coverage of the Gold Coast's sporting teams, the city's most amazing properties, the hottest gossip, and more.

feeds.title: Tasmanian Times
feeds.description: Tasmania's independent news magazine since 2002. Tasmanian Times is an independent platform for news, stories, and digital media of all categories about the island of Tasmania, Australia.

feeds.title: Alice Springs News
feeds.description: Alice Springs News is Central Australia's biggest online newspaper. Erwin Chlanda happily runs the Alice Springs News, delivering his love for Central Australia and all forms of aviation through his journalism.

feeds.title: Townsville Bulletin
feeds.description: The Townsville Bulletin has been a part of the lives of North Queenslanders since 1881. Through the coverage of local, national, and international events, we aim to inform, entertain and lead public debate, always with an unspoken charter of looking after your interests.

feeds.title: NT News
feeds.description: NT News has been serving the people of the Northern Territory for more than 60 years. The NT News is unconventional, bold, unique, and unashamedly Territorian, and allows readers to escape the daily grind and to be informed while also enjoying the lighter side of life.

feeds.title: Tech Business News
feeds.description: Tech Business News is a reliable online resource of information & news in the technology sector. It features articles about the latest trends in the technology industry, including new software releases, Telco, IT & cyber security.

feeds.title: Westside Community News
feeds.description: Westside Community News is a locally owned and operated news aggregator and publisher dedicated to delivering the latest breaking news from the West Brisbane Community and around the world.

feeds.title: The Mercury
feeds.description: Read News, stories and pictures from the small island state at the bottom of Australia. Satisfy your daily need to be informed as a Tasmanian or as someone interested in Tasmania. The Mercury aim to engage, entertain and educate Tasmanians and fans of Tasmania.

feeds.title: Daily Telegraph » Lismore
feeds.description: The Northern Star is the sole daily newspaper dedicated to the dynamic population of NSW's Northern Rivers region. It focuses strongly on providing a voice for its readers while keeping them up-to-date with local, national, and international news. From sports results, property, and rural news, to health, entertainment and travel, it's all covered by The Northern Star.

feeds.title: Daily Telegraph » Coffs Harbour
feeds.description: Having celebrated its centenary in 2007, The Coffs Coast Advocate is a local institution for residents of Coffs Harbour and surrounding districts and is the only daily newspaper dedicated to the region. It directly reflects the coastal community it services, and also features content on healthy living, environmental concerns, travel, entertainment, local business, motoring, and more.

feeds.title: Daily Telegraph » Grafton
feeds.description: Clarence Valley jobs, news, weather, cars and more brought to you by The Daily Examiner.

feeds.title: The Courier Mail » Whitsunday
feeds.description: For all your news and events around Whitsunday, the Whitsunday Coast Guardian, Whitsunday Times and Bowen Independent have you covered. Get the latest updates on sports and local news.

feeds.title: Daily Telegraph » Ballina
feeds.description: For all your news and events around Ballina, Ballina Shire Advocate has you covered. Get the latest updates on sports and local news.
